newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway stock up on U.S. economic data.
newsitem.headline: Norway stock up on U.S. economic data.

text.p: The Norwegian Total index jumped to another all-time high on Friday after the release of reassuring September producer prices in the United States.
The index finished 0.47 percent higher at 873.73 in moderate turnover of 656 million crowns after hitting an intra-day high of 874.47 points.
The index fell on Thursday on profit-taking after a week of bullish trade, and the market was quiet on Friday until the U.S. PPI figures came in the afternoon, dealers said.
Industrial giant Norsk Hydro, which has a 20 percent weighting on the Total index, closed 0.65 percent higher at 311 crowns.
The shipping index went particularly well with shipping group Bergesen B shares climbing 2.82 percent to close at 146 crowns.
